notes:
v0.6.43: start_pavucontrol.sh now starts pulseaudio on demand.

Operator reported 2026-09-09 16:15 MDT: clicking the
"Start pavucontrol" button on the launcher opens a window
that spins forever — it never connects to a pulseaudio
server.

Root cause: pulseaudio is installed (the apt package is
on the box) but no service unit is enabled. Debian ships
pulseaudio.service in /usr/lib/systemd/user/ (a per-user
service), not in /lib/systemd/system/. The user's
pulseaudio.service would start on graphical login, but
the bootstrap doesn't enable user services (no
loginctl enable-linger). So pavucontrol launches, can't
find a pulseaudio socket in /run/user/1000/pulse/, and
spins forever.

Fix: start_pavucontrol.sh now starts pulseaudio on demand
before launching pavucontrol, with the --exit-idle-time=-1
flag so pulseaudio stays alive even with no active clients.
Idempotent: pgrep checks if pulseaudio is already running
and skips if so. The pulseaudio and pavucontrol processes
are both nohup'd so they survive the script's exit (same
SIGHUP fix as v0.6.40 for modem73_loopback).

Effect: clicking the Start pavucontrol button on a fresh
flash now opens the pavucontrol GUI connected to a
working pulseaudio server.
